metadata.description: Conclave — Scrum for Claude Code and Cursor teams. Specialized AI subagents for every discipline (Tech Lead, Frontend, Backend, QA, Designer, DevOps) plus optional PM/SM process roles. All artifacts are plain markdown committed to git in a visible conclave/ directory. Cursor package: platforms/cursor/ (conclave-cursor).

plugins.name: conclave
plugins.description: Scrum methodology for distributed engineering teams using Claude Code (Cursor sibling: platforms/cursor/ conclave-cursor). Twelve shipped slash commands (/conclave-init, /conclave-spec, /conclave-planning, /conclave-dev, /conclave-qa, /conclave-pr-review, /conclave-board, /conclave-sprint, /conclave-story, /conclave-adr, /conclave-bug, /conclave-dora). One autonomous delivery loop: /conclave-dev --loop runs the active sprint (or just the IDs you pass, bugs included) through three waves — Dev+CI, QA, forced Tech Lead — with a recurring local-time schedule, budgets, a run report with agent-productivity stats, and Slack templates. It never merges: approved PRs are left for a human (ADR-006). Also covers Day-0 founding artifacts, per-story delivery, DORA metrics, Kanban board, PM/TL authoring, and post-merge bugs. Discipline-first roster; lean / full-scrum / custom; UAT via Playwright/Newman; per-role models; project_language for multilingual teams.
